# SBOM API

15 endpoints. Request and response schemas are described on the [schemas page](schemas.md); the other tags are listed in the [API index](README.md).

## Endpoints

### `GET /.well-known/openartifact/attestation-key.pem`

Attestation public key

The PEM (PKIX) public key that verifies SBOM and VEX attestations, for `cosign verify-blob-attestation --key`. Unauthenticated.

**Authentication:** none (public endpoint).

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | PEM public key | `application/x-pem-file`: string |
| `501` | Attestations are not enabled | - |

### `GET /api/v1/admin/attestation`

Describe the attestation signing key

Admin only. The key signs `?attest=` SBOM and VEX downloads; its public half is also served unauthenticated at `public_key_url`.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Success | `application/json`: [AttestationKey](schemas.md#attestationkey) |
| `501` | Attestations are not enabled | - |
| `default` | Error | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `PUT /api/v1/repositories/{name}/attestation-attach`

Set the referrer-attach setting

Admin only; hosted docker repositories only. When on, a generated SBOM and a finished vulnerability scan attach a signed SBOM and VEX attestation to the image as OCI referrers. Off by default.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: [AttestationAttachSettings](schemas.md#attestationattachsettings)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Saved | `application/json`: [AttestationAttachSettings](schemas.md#attestationattachsettings) |
| `400` | Not a hosted docker repository | - |
| `404` | Repository not found | - |
| `501` | Attestations are not enabled | - |
| `default` | Error | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `POST /api/v1/repositories/{name}/sbom/generate`

Generate SBOM

Generate a Software Bill of Materials for a repository artifact. Components are the dependencies declared by the stored package file (manifest and lockfile) merged with the artifact's `dependencies` property.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `artifact_id` | string (uuid) | yes | - |
| `format` | string | yes | `cyclonedx` (JSON), `spdx` (2.3 tag-value), `spdx-json` (2.3 JSON) or `spdx3-json` (SPDX 3.0.1 JSON-LD). One of: `cyclonedx`, `spdx`, `spdx-json`, `spdx3-json`. |
| `metadata` | object | no | - |
| `spec_version` | string | no | CycloneDX 1.4, 1.5 (default) or 1.6; SPDX 2.3; SPDX 3 3.0.1. Optional. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | SBOM generation started | - |
| `422` | The artifact's package file is too large or ambiguous to be read safely (`unsafe_artifact`) | - |

### `POST /api/v1/repositories/{name}/sbom/{id}/attach`

Attach a signed SBOM to its docker image

Admin only. Signs the stored SBOM (JSON formats only) and attaches the Sigstore bundle to the image manifest as an OCI referrer; an earlier attachment of the same predicate is replaced.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `id` | path | string | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | An identical attestation was already attached | `application/json`: [AttestationAttachResult](schemas.md#attestationattachresult) |
| `201` | Attached | `application/json`: [AttestationAttachResult](schemas.md#attestationattachresult) |
| `400` | Not a hosted docker repository, or not a JSON SBOM | - |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `404` | Repository, report or image not found | - |
| `507` | Repository storage quota exceeded | - |
| `default` | Error | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `GET /api/v1/repositories/{name}/sbom/{id}/download`

Download SBOM report

Download an SBOM report file

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | - |
| `attest` | query | string | no | `true` returns the document as a signed in-toto attestation in a DSSE envelope; `bundle` returns a Sigstore bundle, the input of `cosign verify-blob-attestation`. Verify with the key from `/.well-known/openartifact/attestation-key.pem`. One of: `true`, `bundle`. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | SBOM file, or its attestation with `attest` | `application/octet-stream`: string (binary); `application/vnd.dev.sigstore.bundle.v0.3+json`: object; `application/vnd.dsse.envelope.v1+json`: object |
| `400` | Invalid attest value, or the SBOM is not a JSON document (SPDX tag-value cannot be attested) | - |
| `404` | SBOM report not found | - |
| `501` | Attestations are not enabled | - |

### `GET /api/v1/repositories/{name}/vex`

Download a VEX document

Build an OpenVEX 0.2.0 (default) or CycloneDX VEX document from the latest vulnerability scans and the recorded VEX decisions. With `artifact_id` it covers one artifact, otherwise every scanned artifact of the repository. Status per vulnerability: the recorded decision; else `fixed` when the scan's `fixed_in` is at or below the artifact version; else `affected` when the scan quarantined the artifact; else `under_investigation`. `not_affected` only comes from a recorded decision. Admin only.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `format` | query | string | no | One of: `openvex`, `cyclonedx`. Default: `openvex`. |
| `spec_version` | query | string | no | CycloneDX spec version (1.4, 1.5 or 1.6; default 1.5). CycloneDX only. |
| `artifact_id` | query | string | no | Restrict the document to one artifact (`name@version`). |
| `attest` | query | string | no | `true` returns the document as a signed in-toto attestation in a DSSE envelope; `bundle` returns a Sigstore bundle, the input of `cosign verify-blob-attestation`. Verify with the key from `/.well-known/openartifact/attestation-key.pem`. One of: `true`, `bundle`. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | VEX document, or its attestation with `attest` | `application/json`: object; `application/vnd.dev.sigstore.bundle.v0.3+json`: object; `application/vnd.dsse.envelope.v1+json`: object |
| `400` | Invalid format, spec_version or artifact_id | - |
| `404` | Repository not found | - |
| `501` | Attestations are not enabled | - |

### `PUT /api/v1/repositories/{name}/vex/statements`

Record a VEX decision

Record (or replace) the decision for one vulnerability of one artifact. `not_affected` requires a `justification`; other statuses must not carry one. Admin only.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action_statement` | string | no | - |
| `artifact_id` | string | yes | - |
| `impact_statement` | string | no | - |
| `justification` | string | no | One of: `component_not_present`, `vulnerable_code_not_present`, `vulnerable_code_not_in_execute_path`, `vulnerable_code_cannot_be_controlled_by_adversary`, `inline_mitigations_already_exist`. |
| `status` | string | yes | One of: `affected`, `not_affected`, `fixed`, `under_investigation`. |
| `vuln_id` | string | yes | e.g. CVE-2024-1234 or GHSA-xxxx |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Recorded decision | `application/json`: [VEXStatement](schemas.md#vexstatement) |
| `400` | Validation failed | - |
| `404` | Repository not found | - |

### `DELETE /api/v1/repositories/{name}/vex/statements/{id}`

Delete a VEX decision

Delete a recorded VEX decision; the vulnerability falls back to its derived status. Admin only.

**Parameters**

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Responses**

|---|---|---|
| `204` | Decision deleted | - |
